notes.title: We changed the whole game ! Update #2
notes.content:
It's been a while since I came with an update, but that's not because I haven't been working on the game. It's because this is quite a big update. Which you can play right now, if you try out the demo.

The reason why this is a bigger update is because the game before was quite bare bones, it featured one level and two guns. I wanted to expand the game and figure out the gameplay loop. My initial idea was to create 3 different levels and then maybe a boos in the end, however I'm a big fan of procedural generation so why not have endless levels and then a leaderboard? That's why I implemented, that and more is descripted in this video devlog:

[previewyoutube=fCff0DYWYbE;full][/previewyoutube]

I also did a intro to the game, which is described in this devlog:

[previewyoutube=qQK9a3fGHww;full][/previewyoutube]

Needless to say a lot of stuff happened, I hope you will try it out and spill some blood. Let me know what you think.

/Dennis
